SELECT d.id, d.merchant_id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, m.status AS merchantStatus, m.apply_status AS merchantApplyStatus, d.canteen_id AS canteenId, c.name AS canteenName, d.stall_id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, d.category_id AS categoryId, cg.name AS categoryName, d.name, d.description, d.price, d.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, d.average_score AS averageScore, d.taste_score AS tasteScore, d.portion_score AS portionScore, d.value_score AS valueScore, d.status, d.is_join_lottery AS isJoinLottery, d.view_count AS viewCount, d.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, d.review_count AS reviewCount, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM dish d INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id LEFT JOIN category cg ON cg.id = d.category_id WHERE d.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lottery_pool ( source_type, source_id, merchant_id, canteen_id, stall_id, category_id, title, price, score, cover_image_url, recommend_reason, weight, status ) SELECT 'DISH', d.id, d.merchant_id, d.canteen_id, d.stall_id, d.category_id, d.name, d.price, d.average_score, d.cover_image_url, NULL, 100, CASE WHEN d.is_join_lottery = 1 AND d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END FROM dish d WHERE d.id = #{dishId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE merchant_id = VALUES(merchant_id), canteen_id = VALUES(canteen_id), stall_id = VALUES(stall_id), category_id = VALUES(category_id), title = VALUES(title), price = VALUES(price), score = VALUES(score), cover_image_url = VALUES(cover_image_url), status = VALUES(status), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE lottery_pool SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE source_type = 'DISH' AND source_id = #{dishId}
mapper.select: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ur.user_id) FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE r.role_code = 'STUDENT' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS studentCount, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM merchant m INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status != 'DISABLED' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS merchantCount, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dish ) AS dishCount, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM review WHERE status = 'VISIBLE' ) AS reviewCount, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lottery_record WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS todayLotteryCount, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM user_activity_log WHERE occurred_at >= CURDATE() AND occurred_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS todayActiveUsers

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, m.name AS merchantName, d.view_count AS viewCount, d.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, d.review_count AS reviewCount, d.average_score AS averageScore FROM dish d INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id WHERE d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') AND m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = 'OPEN' AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND c.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY (d.view_count + d.favorite_count * 3 + d.review_count * 2) DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, c.name AS canteenName, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') THEN d.id END) AS dishCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') THEN d.view_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS viewCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') THEN d.favorite_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS favoriteCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') THEN d.review_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reviewCount, m.average_score AS averageScore FROM merchant m INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = m.stall_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = s.canteen_id LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.merchant_id = m.id WHERE m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = 'OPEN' AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND c.status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY m.id, m.name, c.name, m.average_score ORDER BY (viewCount + favoriteCount * 3 + reviewCount * 2) DESC, merchantId DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS canteenId, c.name AS canteenName, c.type AS canteenType, c.average_score AS averageScore, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status = 'VISIBLE' THEN r.id END) AS reviewCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.status != 'OFF_SHELF' THEN d.id END) AS dishCount FROM canteen c LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.canteen_id = c.id LEFT JOIN review r ON r.dish_id = d.id WHERE c.status != 'DISABLED' GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.type, c.average_score ORDER BY c.average_score DESC, c.id ASC
